verdict.rationale: Cline documents persistent cron-scheduled agents that run independently of any terminal session, which covers time-based triggers. Event-driven triggering is only available indirectly, by running Cline headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab or other pipelines, so the external CI system has to define the event rules. Auto Approve controls what Cline may do without prompting, not when it starts. Missing for 10: native event-trigger rules (e.g., hooks on file changes, commits, PRs or issues), documentation of rule definition syntax, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
